title: Sara Duterte camp denies China ties amid Trillanes funding claims

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday denied having ties to China following accusations that businesses linked to her and her husband, Manases Carpio, received millions of pesos from the Chinese government and entities. Duterte’s spokesperson, Atty. Paolo Panelo Jr., made the statement after former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV claimed at a recent press conference that CALLE88 Foods Corp., a company linked to Carpio, received P319 million from the Chinese government. Trillanes also claimed that a foundation where Duterte is an incorporator, the Tapang at Malasakit Alliance for the Philippines Inc., received a P150 million donation […]...
